title: Your favourite songs, and your own banner
notes: Tap ♥ on the boombox (or beside any song in the list) to keep a song in My Music. ⏭ plays the next favourite, shuffle picks one, ⏮ goes back.
My Music shows the day’s song and all your favourites, each a tap from playing.
Tap the banner picture to change it — any of your photos, or one from your phone.
